column1: # HAETAE implementation 1.2.0 (KS draft specification 260825/260904), the official
# release linked from https://kpqc.cryptolab.co.kr/haetae (Google Drive; sha256 pinned in
# .source, which the Makefile checks). The newer code is not on GitHub: CryptoLabInc/HAETAE
# only has 1.1.2. The release contains the reference implementation only (its kat.sh
# mentions an optimized_implementation/ AVX2 tree that the archive does not include), so
# this is the reference build (-O3 -march=native). Sizes match include/params.h, the
# specification (Table 3) and data/schemes/HAETAE.yaml; our build of the reference code
# reproduces the shipped KATs for all three modes.
# Columns: file, name, pk, sk, sig, iters, mode (HAETAE_CONFIG_MODE value)
